name: Dirty Texts: New Intern
source:
In "New Intern" you play the role of a man who's the CEO of Hookstone Marketing Ltd, one of the nations most important marketing corporations. The game starts when a new employee, Sophie, takes a position as your intern. It's your responsibility to guide and groom Sophie to become a successful, productive asset for the company. Will you succeed?

Sophie is a smart girl who just started to work for a marketing company as an intern. She is in a relatively one-sided relationship with a man who doesn't properly appreciate her. Will she find in you the mentor she needs to help her succeed professionally, or will she discover that you are truly the man of her dreams? Then again, maybe she'll fall for you so hard that she'll be willing to fulfill all of your desires, no matter how dark.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2528870/Dirty_Texts__New_Intern/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在“新实习生”中，你扮演的角色是Hookstone Marketing Ltd的首席执行官，该公司是美国最重要的营销公司之一。当新员工索菲担任你的实习生时，游戏就开始了。你有责任引导和培养Sophie成为公司成功、富有成效的资产。你会成功吗？

苏菲是一个聪明的女孩，刚开始在一家营销公司实习。她与一个不太欣赏她的男人处于一种相对片面的关系。她会在你身上找到她需要的导师来帮助她在职业上取得成功，还是会发现你确实是她的梦中情人？话又说回来，也许她会深深地爱上你，以至于愿意满足你所有的愿望，无论多么黑暗。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2528870/Dirty_Texts__New_Intern/]Steam[/url]]
